theorem norm_S_eta2_le_gx {α x δ : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 2.16e20 ≤ x)
    (h : Approx2 α x δ a q (3 / 4 * x ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))) (hq : (q : ℝ) ≤ x ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6)
    (hr3 : 3 ≤ max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q) :
    ‖S eta2 x α‖ ≤ gx x (max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q) * x :=

note: The first case holds in Lean with 0.8764, 2.526 and 3.8x^{5/6} in place of 0.5, 2.5 and 3.36x^{5/6}; 2.526 comes from c₀ = 32 and Lean's ψ(V) ≤ 1.0064V (book 1.0004). Erratum: In (6.77) [H] prints the AM-GM constant as (1/2)(log2/√ρ+(√ρ/2)·0.67506) = 0.49911 (stated as 0.5); the correct value is 0.81020, so [H]'s own (6.63) exceeds (3.2) by up to 2.65% for prime q and 3.19% at q = 60060.
